artifacts.summary: Seven-phase plan: re-derive the live 10-anchor wave, re-pin it in two cost-ordered passes with a dated drift-correction entry, then three parallel prose phases (C15-coupled Lean docstrings + theorem-index, paper-attribution rewrite in axiom-reference and both Typst documents, pre-788 count tables) and a full gate sweep with a conditional acceptance statement.

memory_candidates.content: When planning a multi-file documentation-consistency task, let GATE COUPLING set the phase boundaries, not directory structure. Two complementary rules fell out of the BX/TM membership-prose pass in BimodalLogic: (1) Files bound to each other by a cross-file invariant check must share one phase with Commit Mode: atomic-batch -- there, check-module-invariants.sh's C15 asserts that every docs/theorem-index.md row's paper-anchor cell also appears as a `Paper:` line at the Lean declaration, so changing either side alone turns the gate red in a way that reads as a regression. (2) Where a gate is structurally BLIND to the defect class (C14's stale-literal set was {14,21,42,44,45} and its markdown scope excluded nested FormalSystem/**/README.md, so two tables asserting 'Total 29' under their own correct '20 constructors' sentence both passed), the phase's Tier Justification must name an explicit re-derivation from a generator script as its covering check -- a gate verdict there is a vacuous pass and must not be cited as evidence. Read the gate's source to establish its scope and literal set rather than inferring coverage from its name.
